text.text_excerpt: I didn't get a chance to karaoke (what's wrong with me?!) but I have to say that if I lived in New Orleans this would probably be my karaoke spot. They have a pretty extensive catalog. Kajun's is a dive bar so don't expect fancy. It has low ceilings, dark interior and a glowing neon light in the front window. Of course you have a fine selection of New Orleans beers to choose from, and they are CHEAP. I loved sitting at the bar. The food is pretty good for bar food and affordable (note: order from the man with the iPad walking around the room).

We had a great time here last night! There was a great crowd, friendly and having fun. The karaoke was a blast! The drinks were strong, top shelf and prices reasonable. The bartenders amazing. Plenty of off street parking and several restaurants nearby. I enjoy life in general. I enjoy Kajun's Pub specifically! Try it...you will too!

LOVED my experience the other night karaoking at Kajun's Pub. Food was fantastic! Ordered the chicken wings, poutine and a garlic sausage. Everything was yummy and I would go back for the food alone. Really great quality restaurant food in a bar. The karaoke was great! Loved all the song selection. The only thing I missed are the HUGE books that contain all the songs. Would have loved to flip through the books instead of standing by the computer trying to do the same. Loved the dj and all the characters that were there singing.
